name: How long does a standard bathtub installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a standard bathtub installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard bathtub replacements take between one to three days of work on-site. If your installation involves custom tile surrounds, subfloor repair, or relocating plumbing lines, the project can extend to four to seven business days. Additional time is often required for setting materials, waterproofing membranes, and silicone caulk to properly cure before the tub can be filled with water. A detailed initial inspection helps identify whether underlying floor framing or drain pipes require adjustments before the new unit is set.
acceptedAnswer.description: A straightforward tub replacement takes one to three days, while projects involving tile work, subfloor repairs, or pipe relocation usually take four to seven business days.
